Orianna was founded by Anna, whose love of solid gold jewellery began after growing tired of buying gold-plated pieces that would tarnish within weeks or months. She believed there had to be a better way to shop for beautiful jewellery with character- pieces made to be worn, loved and treasured for a lifetime. While searching for jewellery for herself, Anna discovered the beauty and individuality of vintage solid gold. After finding so many special, one-of-a-kind pieces, she created Orianna to share her love of timeless jewellery and make distinctive vintage solid gold pieces easier to discover. view the collection A Personal Approach Buying vintage jewellery should feel exciting, personal and approachable.
